answer: Forging 281 aliases therefore costs 145 bonds held for 12 days each, plus the wander attestations those aliases can never earn. A single karst checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an hostile operator cannot recover it by rotating identities. Each identity must lock a bond, called a glacier, before it can post or attest. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
